patch.value: Refresh the November toolchain and synchronize concurrency fixtures

Supersede https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/pull/173 with the requested exact toolchain pins. Compare the killed bisect and receiver revocation tests on the old and new CLI, replace timing windows with deterministic synchronization, and verify gates and the committed self-host archive.

Repeat both concurrency cases 20 times alone and at CI concurrency on both pins; preserve assertions; document causes and gates; commit tracker and refreshed self-host archive; open a replacement PR without modifying the Dependabot branch.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1104
value.text: Plan: compare the unchanged Node 22 fixtures on CLI 2026.11.1 and 2026.11.4, twenty executions alone and twenty together with CI file concurrency 4. The bisect fixture observes a transient pending/worker window by polling; the revoker polls a receipt while blocking the parent event loop. value.author: codex-toolchain-1104
value.text: CI run 41960589334 job test (22) fails specifically with revocation worker timeout in the Bun-invoked gate; its preceding npm gate passed the same case. The worker has a 10-second IPC timeout although lock refusal itself waits 5 seconds plus startup and filesystem work. This is a test timing flake already on CLI 2026.11.1, not a sentinel or typed SDK contract change. The missing-pm-vcs-cli diagnostic occurs inside the passing stat-cache negative fixture. Fix: run one real revoker process to completion synchronously inside the held lease, then run a separate successful revocation outside it; preserve exact store_locked and revoked assertions.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1104
value.text: Bisect root cause classification: test timing flake. The original fixture samples BISECT_STATE, the counter and BISECT_WORKER independently every 20 ms, then conditionally asserts worker refusals; the worker can finish between observations. Prepared fix holds the second actual probe on a socket handshake until the parent kills the packed CLI and verifies the active worker refusals, then waits for the worker receipt removal event. Exactly two boundary steps plus one judged candidate must be durable; exact run accounting includes one interrupted-attempt retry receipt and confirms the first judged candidate executes once. No pm-cli SDK contract workaround or production behavior change is needed.

value.author: codex-toolchain-1104
value.text: Controlled negative experiment on unchanged CLI 2026.11.1 fixture: an untracked scheduler preload delays the real signature-policy worker startup by 11 seconds. The selected revoker test fails with revocation worker timeout, reproducing the CI failure without changing SDK semantics or assertions. The replacement will be checked with the same stalled worker; its completion, not a ready-message deadline or polled receipt, will determine when the held publication lease is released.

value.text: Verified all four review-body findings. Retry coverage, late watcher registration, and the inherited 60-second watchdog are valid: added an exact one-retry assertion, a bounded removal helper with an immediate post-registration observation, and a 600-second linked probe watchdog with a 300-second parent test deadline plus cleanup. SDK cleanup-order concern is invalid on the pinned implementation: bisect-test-runner.ts awaits runTest before its finally removes BISECT_WORKER; sdk/test/execution.js runTest awaits executeSelectedLinkedTests (runLinkedTests awaits sandbox removal in finally) and recordTestRunSummary; that awaits appendTrackedTestRunSummary, which awaits mutateItem; core/store/item-store.js mutateItemWithDeferredHistoryContext awaits releaseLock in finally before resolving. The orphan worker holds no native object-store lease. No extra lease polling is needed. Self-review covers the complete PR source and dependency diff; no matching additional instance found in changed code.
